record.paper_title: Regularity of maximal operators: recent progress and some open problems
record.original_question: For 0 < beta < 1, define the one-dimensional discrete centered fractional maximal operator by M_beta f(n) = sup_{r>=0} (2r+1)^{beta-1} sum_{k=-r}^{r} |f(n+k)|, where r ranges over nonnegative integers. Let q = 1/(1-beta), and for a sequence g define Var_q(g) = (sum_{n in Z} |g(n+1)-g(n)|^q)^{1/q}. If f: Z -> R has bounded variation and M_beta f is not identically infinite, is there a universal constant C such that Var_q(M_beta f) <= C Var(f)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix a parameter $0<\beta<1$ and define the one-dimensional discrete centered fractional maximal operator acting on a function $f:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{R}$ by
$$M_\beta f(n)\;=\;\sup_{r\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}}\,(2r+1)^{\beta-1}\sum_{k=-r}^{r}|f(n+k)|,\qquad n\in\mathbb{Z}.$$
For a sequence $g:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{R}$ and an exponent $1\le q<\infty$, set
$$\mathrm{Var}_q(g)\;=\;\Bigl(\sum_{n\in\mathbb{Z}}|g(n+1)-g(n)|^{q}\Bigr)^{1/q},$$
and write $\mathrm{Var}(g)=\mathrm{Var}_1(g)$. Let $q=1/(1-\beta)$.

Question: Does there exist a constant $C=C(\beta)>0$ such that, for every $f:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{R}$ with $\mathrm{Var}(f)<\infty$ and $M_\beta f\not\equiv\infty$, one has
$$\mathrm{Var}_q\bigl(M_\beta f\bigr)\;\le\;C\,\mathrm{Var}(f)\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The centered discrete one-dimensional case at the endpoint $q=1/(1-\beta)$ appears to remain open. While analogous endpoint inequalities have been established for the uncentered discrete fractional maximal operator and for one-sided variants (work by Carneiro–Madrid and others), and continuity at the endpoint is known to fail in some settings, no proof of the centered $\mathrm{Var}_q$-to-$\mathrm{Var}$ bound has been located in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Regularity of Maximal Operators: Recent Progress and Some Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems on the regularity of maximal operators, including discrete fractional endpoint variation questions.
status_evidence.claim: The question on the centered discrete fractional maximal operator's $\mathrm{Var}_q$ bound is posed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: On the regularity of one-sided fractional maximal functions
status_evidence.snippet: Sharp bounds and continuity for discrete one-sided fractional maximal operators from $\ell^1(\mathbb{Z})$ to BV($\mathbb{Z}$).
status_evidence.claim: Endpoint results are known in one-sided / uncentered cases, leaving the centered case as the difficult one.

status_evidence.title: Endpoint Sobolev and BV continuity for maximal operators
status_evidence.snippet: Studies endpoint Sobolev and BV continuity for maximal operators in continuous and discrete settings.
status_evidence.claim: Endpoint regularity for the centered fractional case is delicate and not fully resolved.
